title: 5.4.11 Lab: Three Enemies in three variables
description: Instantiate e1, e2, and e3 from the Enemy class at three different positions: three independent instances, each in its own named variable.

steps.title: Create e1, e2, e3 at three different positions
steps.instructions: In `setup()`, create three Enemy instances: `e1`, `e2`, and `e3`, at three different x/y positions. Each call to `new Enemy(x, y, hp)` produces a separate object with its own state.
hints: Open the moSHion docs drawer on the right and review how constructor arguments work: each Enemy takes an x, y, and hp value.

requirements.title: Three separate new Enemy(...) calls
requirements.description: Create three Enemy instances: `e1`, `e2`, and `e3`, in `setup()`. Each must be a distinct `new Enemy(...)` call.

requirements.title: e1 assigned to a new Enemy
requirements.description: Assign the first Enemy instance to the variable `e1`.

requirements.title: e2 assigned to a new Enemy
requirements.description: Assign the second Enemy instance to the variable `e2`.

requirements.title: e3 assigned to a new Enemy
requirements.description: Assign the third Enemy instance to the variable `e3`.
